title: Validation failures return 422 rather than the 400 implied by the spec
evidence: src/lib.rs:81-84 ApiError::Validation maps to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422); TASK.md/REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says rejected (400). Malformed/wrong-type JSON does return 400 (lib.rs:80).
suggestion: Acceptable REST semantics (422 for semantic validation), but if strict 400 conformance is desired, map ApiError::Validation to BAD_REQUEST.

title: Implementation exceeds low-effort minimum
evidence: src/lib.rs: case-insensitive author filter (line 195), poisoned-lock recovery (line 133), graceful shutdown (main.rs:13), distinct 400/404/422 error bodies, testable lib/main split.
suggestion: None — noted as a strength for cross-run comparison.
